name: lemeng.inventory.snapshot.backfill.hp.3120
_note: 库存快照**大容量回填变体**（#1318）：老日期单日 5~6 万行，静态 30 页（6,000 行）必截断。
① drv 生成页号 1..401（数据页 1..400 + 哨兵页 401），ctl.foreach 逐页拉（并发 8），
子管线 lemeng.inventory.snapshot.page 每页写一个 staging chunk（空页写占位行）。
② 三道闸：页到齐（gpage/dpages）→ 哨兵页必须为空（gsent/sentinel）→ 源端零行（die_empty）。
③ rows 剔除占位行与哨兵页后进 shape，契约闸与写湖与主管线一致。

properties.message: SOURCE_NOT_PUBLISHED: bizday=${BIZDAY} 源端零行——该营业日没有匹配的结转记录。本管线是**回填通道**：必须经 POST /api/run 显式传 params={BIZDAY:"YYYY-MM-DD"} 驱动。参数形状正确仍为零 ⇒ 源端这一天确实没结转：登记进正典 §1.7 台账后跳过，别反复重试。
lemeng inventory_snapshot 容量截断：哨兵页（第 401 页）仍有数据（{rows} 行）⇒ 单日行数击穿 400×200=80000 行上限（#1318）。处置：提高 drv 的页数并同步哨兵页号，重生成后端再跑。

properties.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "drv" AS
WITH pg AS (
  SELECT CAST(x AS INTEGER) AS page_no FROM generate_series(1, 401) t(x)
)
SELECT CAST('${BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       strftime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ') AS batch_id,
       CAST(page_no AS INTEGER) AS page_number,
       '401' AS n_pages
FROM pg ORDER BY page_no

SELECT CAST(cur.batch_id AS VARCHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(cur.system_book AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST(cur.bizday AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(cur.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(cur.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(cur.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(cur.storehouse_num AS BIGINT) AS storehouse_num,
       CAST(cur.storehouse_code AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_code,
       CAST(cur.storehouse_name AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_name,
       CAST(cur.item_num AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
       CAST(cur.item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
       CAST(cur.item_barcode AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
       CAST(cur.item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
       CAST(cur.item_spec AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
       CAST(cur.item_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_unit,
       CAST(cur.inventory_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_quantity,
       CAST(cur.inventory_assist_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_assist_quantity,
       CAST(cur.inventory_use_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_use_quantity,
       CAST(cur.inventory_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS inventory_money,
       CAST(cur.carry_cost_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS carry_cost_price,
       CAST(cur.sale_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS sale_price,
       CAST(cur.difference_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS difference_quantity,
       CAST(cur.difference_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS difference_money,
       CAST(cur.page_num AS INTEGER) AS page_num,
       CAST(cur.page_rows AS INTEGER) AS page_rows,
       CAST(cur.is_placeholder AS INTEGER) AS is_placeholder,
       CAST(cur.file_page AS INTEGER) AS file_page
FROM (
  SELECT *, CAST(regexp_extract(filename, 'chunk-([0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z)-p([0-9]+)\.parquet$', 2) AS INTEGER) AS file_page,
            regexp_extract(filename, 'chunk-([0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z)-p([0-9]+)\.parquet$', 1) AS file_batch
  FROM read_parquet('/workspace/.duckle-stage/inventory_page/*.parquet', filename = true)
) cur
CROSS JOIN (SELECT any_value(batch_id) AS batch_id, max(CAST(n_pages AS INTEGER)) AS n_pages FROM "drv") e
WHERE cur.file_batch = e.batch_id

SELECT 'pages_missing' AS violation,
       CAST(count(DISTINCT file_page) AS VARCHAR) AS detail,
       CAST(any_value((SELECT max(CAST(n_pages AS INTEGER)) FROM "drv")) AS VARCHAR) AS expected
FROM input
HAVING count(DISTINCT file_page) <> (SELECT max(CAST(n_pages AS INTEGER)) FROM "drv")
